description: Land Acquisition - Olaithoduvai, Mannar Town D/S Division, Mannar District - Kaddukarankudiyiruppu, Mannar Town D/S Division, Mannar District - Amended Extraordinary Gaz. No. 1887/41 and 07.11.2014
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and locations in Mannar District. The content focuses exclusively on the government's exercise of power to take possession of land for public purposes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. While it mentions a government minister (Harin Fernando), this is incidental to the land acquisition action being authorized, and there are no detailed portfolio responsibilities or organizational changes described that would trigger a government classification type.
